newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli banks will be closed Friday by strike.
newsitem.headline: Israeli banks will be closed Friday by strike.

text.p: Most Israeli bank branches will be closed on Friday and forex trading will be suspended as employees stage a one-day strike for a shorter work week, a union leader said on Thursday.
"Workers at all the banks will strike except the bank (branches) at border crossings," said Tzion Shama, the head of the bank workers union of the Histadrut labour federation.

He said workers were demanding a move to a five-day work week and would continue striking on Fridays until an agreement was reached. Israeli banks are opened Sundays through Fridays, with the Friday workday ending at 12 p.m.

Bank Hapoalim spokeswoman Miri Bitton said most banks had agreed in principle to a five-day week on condition that all banks participated. But the anti-trust authorities have ruled out any coordination.
She said employees may ask management to move to a five-day workweek while keeping the banks open six days.
